playlist.title: 馬蓋先創意工程學院｜先進半導體封裝：5分鐘俯瞰導覽
playlist.description:
六部各 5 分鐘的三維俯瞰導覽，從技術全貌走近關鍵結構：2.5D／HBM、扇出 RDL、3D 混合鍵合、局部矽橋、Chiplet／UCIe，以及散熱、測試與可靠度。
Six five-minute 3D fly-throughs of advanced semiconductor packaging: 2.5D/HBM, fan-out RDL, hybrid bonding, silicon bridges, chiplets/UCIe, and thermal/test/reliability.
教學重建，非廠房實拍；MP4 無聲，解說由獨立字幕提供。 / Educational reconstruction, not factory footage. Silent MP4s with separate explanatory captions.

videos.title: 01｜2.5D 矽中介層與 HBM｜5分鐘俯瞰導覽 · 2.5D interposer & HBM
videos.description:
2.5D 矽中介層與 HBM｜2.5D interposer & HBM
5 分鐘俯瞰導覽：辨認運算晶粒、HBM、矽中介層與基板的角色，沿著互連、供電與熱路徑理解 2.5D 系統；同時區分 CoWoS 不同變體。
A five-minute aerial-style tour: Identify compute dies, HBM, a silicon interposer and the substrate. Follow interconnect, power and heat through a 2.5D system while distinguishing CoWoS variants.

這是以虛擬鏡頭飛行呈現的三維工程教學重建，不是廠房實拍、原廠 CAD 或量測模擬。比例、材質與動態為解說調整，不能由畫面推算製程尺寸、溫度、速度、良率或壽命。
This is an educational 3D reconstruction with a virtual fly-through, not factory footage, vendor CAD or a measurement-based simulation. Scale, materials and motion are adjusted for clarity; the visuals do not provide manufacturing dimensions, temperatures, speeds, yields or lifetime predictions.
